title.en: An Act Renaming the Bacolod - Murcia - San Carlos Road (Bacolod Section) in the City of Bacolod to Romeo G. Guanzon Avenue
title.orig: An Act Renaming the Bacolod - Murcia - San Carlos Road (Bacolod Section) in the City of Bacolod to Romeo G. Guanzon Avenue

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9464_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The 9.62 kilometer stretch comprising the Bacolod Section of the Bacolod - Murcia - San Carlos Road from the junction of Araneta Street to the boundary of Bacolod City and the Municipality of Murcia in Negros Occidental, is hereby renamed as the Romeo G. Guanzon Avenue.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
